title: l1qw.30(a): C deaddrop response-code contract (5.03 storage_full, 4.13, Location-Path/Max-Age on POST)
description: Smallest child of worker6-l1qw.30 (spec 18.9, R-12-079/085/087): lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c — (1) POST success (2.04 at :205) must add Location-Path (deaddrop/<msg-id>) and Max-Age options per spec; (2) store-full admission failure must return 5.03 Service Unavailable with the storage_full diagnostic (not the current generic 5.00 at :163-179 — check which arm fires when lichen_dtn_buffer_message returns false); (3) payload > MAX_PACKET_SIZE must return 4.13 Request Entity Too Large (currently folded into other codes); (4) keep rate-limit 4.29 semantics unchanged. Mirror the Python deaddrop resource (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py) which conforms and is vector-tested. Diagnostic body shape must match Python/deaddrop.json vectors. Zephyr-coupled file (no host harness) — verification via cppcheck gate + review; note the coap_dtn host-test gap for the test-infra follow-up.
